lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4-6 vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible on the anterior lateral flank. The spots are larger and more clearly defined in the mid-lateral zone, tapering in size and luminance towards the dorsal-posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance spots, creating a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral-posterior region of the pectoral fin.
